verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint. The models overview page is a human-readable docs page, the OpenAPI spec names only /v1/chat/completions "and related endpoints", and general OpenAI compatibility does not show that a model-listing endpoint exists. Model-catalog enumeration is a fair axis for an inference API, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
